title: CP-2 DeviceEvent v1alpha1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/events: a device-level record of the engine's status outbox (core/reconciler.py refuse()). It shares the per-device seq with the deployment status records (the cloud drops seq <= last seen per device). Events: DesiredStateRefused, sent once per distinct (document, reason) (lead decision 2026-10-17); FE-4 build events BuildStarted, BuildProgress, BuildLog, BuildSucceeded, BuildFailed of an on-device build (x-flex-build), each with deployment and buildId.

reason.description: Registered text (FE-DS-* for DesiredStateRefused, FE-BLD-* for BuildFailed).

documentDigest.description: sha256 of the refused response body.

offeredManifestVersion.description: manifestVersion of the refused document when it could be read.

deployment.description: Build events: the deployment being built.

buildId.description: Build events: x-flex-build.id of the deployment.

line.description: BuildLog: one output line of the build (stdout and stderr, cut at 2000 characters).

resultDigest.description: BuildSucceeded: digest of what the build produced (the built image id, or the sha256 of the built payload).

profile.description: Build events: the driver profile that builds.
